The Senate convened at 3:00pm.

Agreed to, 96-1: Baldwin amendment #6828 (modify the provision relating to the relationship of this Act to existing law) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Agreed to by voice vote: Scott (SC) amendment to require the disclosure of foreign financing of intercollegiate athletics (#6830) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 1-94: Paul amendment to improve the bill (#6758) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 42-54: Kennedy amendment to limit price increases for college athletics tickets (#6760) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (60-vote affirmative threshold).

Agreed to by voice vote: Moody/Blumenthal amendment to modify the prohibition on certain conference mergers and acquisitions (#6831) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 49-50: Booker amendment to increase the limitation on funding for post-eligibility insurance and catastrophic injury for student athletes (#6805) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 47-52: Booker amendment to establish certain standards with respect to coaches of varsity sports teams (#6835) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Passed, 77-22: Passage of Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026, as amended.

Leader Thune filed cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548, H.R.7008, Stop Insider Trading Act.

Leader Thune filed cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684, H.R.9340, Ratepayer Protection Act.

Leader Thune filed cloture on Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling to be Secretary of Labor.

The Senate will convene at 10:00am on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

The Senate will recess from 12:30-2:15pm for the weekly party lunches.

At 2:15pm, the Senate will proceed to a roll call vote on the motion to proceed to S.J.Res.197 – A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to “Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program”

Leader Thune filed cloture on the following:

  1. Motion to proceed to Cal. #548, H.R.7008, Stop Insider Trading Act.
  2. Motion to proceed to Cal. #684, H.R.9340, Ratepayer Protection Act.
  3. Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling to be Secretary of Labor.

The Senate adjourned at 10:58pm.

content.rendered:
The Senate convened at 3:00pm.

Leader Thune filed cloture on Executive Calendar #830, Kasdin Miller Mitchell to be United States District Judge for the Northern District of Texas.

Invoked, 47-46: Motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #902, Matthew R. Byrne to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio.

The Senate will convene at 10:00am on Tuesday, September 15th and will resume consideration of Executive Calendar #902, Matthew R. Byrne, of Ohio, to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio.

At 11:15am, the Senate will proceed to a roll call vote on confirmation of the Byrne nomination.

Following the confirmation vote on the Byrne nomination, the Senate will recess until 1:50pm for the weekly conference meetings.

At 2:15pm, the Senate will proceed to a roll call vote on the motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #423, H.R.3633, Clarity Act.
